facts.fact: The Procurement Policy Office's Directive No. 53, signed 10 December 2020 and effective 15 December 2020, requires ICT solutions of common use across ministries to be hosted at the Government Online Centre or another data centre or cloud approved by the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation.
facts.system: PPO Directive No. 53, Procurement of ICT Projects

facts.fact: The same directive names the Government Online Centre as the hosting for common-use ICT solutions, with other data centres or clouds only as approved by the ministry; it gives no count of bodies moved.
facts.system: PPO Directive No. 53, Procurement of ICT Projects
